caption"":""This is me.
This is what it looks like when I say yes and mean it. This is me when I feel completely in alignment with my highest self.

This weekend I have stayed my ass in the house. Typically a social person and there were so many things to do. Fun things. With people that I like...BUT I  really felt the need to recharge. 
I thought I was amazing at setting boundaries until I realized how often I do things out of some subconscious moral obligation of thinking people expect things of me. I really can't express how good it felt to say no and not have to explain myself. I got a ton of reading & reflection done and now I feel filled and ready to say yes to more things this upcoming week. 
I want more of me like this and I think the world
column370: my family and friends deserve more of me like this \u2661""
